name: Crew Finance
description:
“Simply put: there is no better way to manage your personal finances than what Crew has built.” -Spencer (Crew user since 2025)

With Crew you can: 

- organize your money into pockets
- link your cards to your pockets for intentional spending
- use Autopilot to program your budget
- add your partner and children to your financial plans

Most budgeting apps stand on the sidelines and tell you what you already spent. Crew is a high-yield checking account with budgeting features built in — It can tell you what you’re spending and saving in real time, and even decline purchases when you’re going over budget. Crew is strong enough to save real money but easy enough to use day-after-day. 

Crew is perfect for: 

- knowing what amount is safe to spend
- helping you aggressively pay down debt or save for goals
- envelope budgeting on the go
- automatically paying yourself first
- giving every dollar a job

It takes most people less than 5 minutes to open an account and — unlike some personal finance and envelope budgeting apps — Crew has no required set-up fees, subscriptions, or minimums. 

Still thinking? Here’s what others have to say about using Crew to manage their banking and personal finances:

“They have the best and coolest features of any banking app that I’ve seen so far, and I’ve tried a few. Everything works super well and you can do SO MANY cool and useful things.” - Jackson

“Financial stress has been a big part of my life and banking through Crew with Autopilot setting aside money for bills, I feel the stress lifting away.” -Kristen

“After hiding monthly bills money from our view, our income-to-outgoing last month was over $1,500, which is honestly unheard of for us. We’re having amazing results!” -Jesika 

“Crew makes a huge difference in our money conversations and makes it easy to understand our spending habits.” -Liz

Still reading?  Aren’t you precocious! If you’re this into the details of a banking app, you’re definitely Crew material. Give it a try!
